<reason>B won a competitive debate by holding the motion to “best” capacity, not a free block button: scarce investigators, badge quality, and funding stayed live after A’s risk-triage and hunting-ground attacks. A was morally sharper and more memorable, but kept sliding “best” into pennies-scale software while never showing how a gift-tier freeze still gets staffed or stays hard to fake. B’s baseline-free / best-sellable comparison was the cleaner vote reason.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s Rebuttal 2: after granting risk-first extortion triage, B showed A’s leftover “pennies” tools were already conceded baseline, so giving away the best human/high-assurance layer still cheapens the badge and unfunds the desk.</best_rebuttal>
